usage: The word 伯母 (baak3 mou5) is a noun and refers specifically to the wife of your father's elder brother.
In a sentence, 伯母 usually comes after a possessive pronoun or name to indicate possession, like '我伯母' (my aunt).
It is important to note that 伯母 is used on the paternal side and indicates the wife of the older brother, not the younger brother.
You can use 伯母 to address the person directly in a polite manner or refer to her when telling stories or explaining family relations.
In conversations about family, 伯母 is a common word to show respect and clarify relationships within the extended family.
